The entire experience was fun, smooth, and memorable, and a big part of that was thanks to Rickie's outstanding customer service. If you're looking for a unique and unforgettable experience, Pixel Rooms is an absolute must-visit! From the moment you walk in, you're immersed in a world of creativity, challenge, and pure fun. The rooms are brilliantly designed with vibrant visuals and interactive puzzles that keep you fully engaged the entire time.
What really stood out was how well everything was put together—each challenge felt fresh and exciting, and the technology worked seamlessly. Whether you're going with friends, family, or even on a date, it's the perfect way to bond, laugh, and test your problem-solving skills.
The staff were also incredibly friendly and helpful, making the whole experience even better. You can tell they genuinely care about making sure everyone has a great time.
Overall, Pixel Rooms delivers an amazing, high-energy experience that’s both entertaining and memorable. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more rooms!

If I could give more than 5 stars for this experience, I would. My team and I had such a blast. The description says, "high energy and interactive experience" - and it sure was! My heart was pumping and water never tasted so good. Highly recommend coming here and it's replayable as well.

Our group expected to break a sweat but I was still not mentally prepared.The moment we started stepping on tiles and taking on the ever-changing challenges, we were fully locked in game mode. It felt like playing "The Floor is Lava" with more lights and music.

Ricky, our game master, was INCREDIBLE. As an escape room enthusiast, I've been to many of the offerings that 60Out had to offer. While this is not an escape room, this experience is a noteworthy addition to their offerings. Ricky made sure that we got the most out of our experience and he was so thoughtful from start to finish.

We had a group of five but you can adjust the difficult of the rooms to fit groups of all shapes and sizes. Don't be afraid of a little friendly competition and make sure to stretch! Can’t wait to go back and beat our Level 3 Gauntlet challenge.

reviews.author: Mariam Margaryan
reviews.text:
A Captivating Experience at Pixel Room

From the moment I stepped into Pixel Room, I was immersed in a world of creativity, color, and pure fun. Every corner of this place is designed to inspire imagination and spark joy. It’s more than just a photo-worthy space — it’s an experience.

What truly elevated my visit, though, was the staff. Warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful, they made sure every moment felt personal and memorable. Whether it was offering tips for the best angles or simply sharing a smile, their passion for creating an unforgettable atmosphere was evident.

Pixel Room isn’t just a place to take pictures — it’s a space to make memories, express yourself, and feel like a work of art. I can’t recommend it enough, and I’ll definitely be back!

Perfect for adults and kids.
Great customer service, kind, and thoughtful staff. Clear instructions for each room.
Variety of games and enough time to play everything. We were never bored! Each room was different than the other. Fun music to keep you going. Something for everyone. We all enjoyed our time here. The floor is Lava was the best. The foam shoes are included with purchase of tickets. Make sure to wear comfy clothing. You’ll be running a lot. If you  like critical thinking, puzzles, Tetris, video games, team building games this place is for you. Fun fun fun.

reviews.text: Wow, this place is SO much fun! I admired this place when I came there with my friends! Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Kate Grey
reviews.text: Such a cool and unique experience! The laser maze was way harder than I expected (in a good way!), and the button room had us running like crazy. Perfect for a fun night out.

reviews.author: Andrey Novikov
reviews.text: Wow, this place is SO much fun! We came with a group of friends and had an absolute blast. The games are super interactive, and the whole space feels like stepping into a video game. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Elmer Pyles
reviews.text: I just got to play through the rooms and boy am I glad I did! Each room and experience got better and better! This space is perfect for gatherings of large groups as well. The staff are very accommodating and eager to provide exceptional customer service to everyone. If you're looking for the best spot to celebrate your next event, this is it! Be ready to sweat!
